notes: Everything fits the new body. The head is sculpted to match it (skull, jaw, cheekbones, brow, nose, lips, ears, real eyes) and sweats, flushes and bruises with it; cuts and blood are painted into the face. Every hairstyle, beard, cap, beanie, bandana, shades and headband is shaped to the head. Shorts, sleeves, knee pads, wristbands, the watch, ankle wraps, the hood and the jacket collar are fitted to the body and bend with it; shoes and gloves are sculpted too. Turf Wars crown: $5,000 and 5,000 XP for holding the most blocks, plus $500 and 500 XP for every block you're ahead of second place. Kicks and spinning moves (like the karate finisher) no longer wring the neck or over-twist the hip, and in street fights you pivot to face an enemy before you punch instead of swinging behind your back.
